channel.title: Sorana releases
channel.description: Release notes for Sorana, the free desktop AI knowledge workspace and agent harness for Windows, Linux, and MacOS, with eight model roles, Git repositories, system logs, music archives, and local models.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.14
item.description: Multi-source workspaces with composition view: add another folder beside the root and every folder becomes its own frame on one canvas, joined by folder connectors with a layer map, composition or single views and graphs. Music archives open like folders: Spotify exports and ListenBrainz history archives group their artists on the canvas, with a review step before grouping and listening history you can query in chat. Git repositories, local or remote, and platform system logs now open as their own grouped boards, with history and event kinds queryable in chat.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.12
item.description: Music exports open like folders and group their artists on the canvas, a review step before grouping, a Spotify listening history you can query in chat, and rebuild or update for folders already in use.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.11
item.description: A prompt rail for stepping through a conversation, documents that open inside the Library, definition and usage lookup across projects, and a Memory Graph that is easier to read.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.10
item.description: Report a bug from inside the app with diagnostics attached, every agent chat listed and manageable from the Agent Manager, and transcripts you can read, compact, or delete in one place.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.9
item.description: 3D graphs of your workspace and of agent memory, sync between your own agents, desktop tab grouping controls, live progress on long rebuilds, and a fresh install that no longer stalls on the splash.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.8
item.description: The Model Manager loads its list on Linux again, the Linux app starts reliably, a folder of two thousand icons no longer freezes the canvas, and category names are no longer taken from reasoning text.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.7
item.description: Cards you can drag anywhere on the agent and health dashboards, a category review before a folder is regrouped, copy and ZIP actions on the canvas, mindmap zoom and fit, and a help panel that works in the installed app.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.6
item.description: Conversations reopen where they stopped, memory work appears as a job on the health dashboard, logins renew before they lapse, and the conversation store is capped so old history is cleared first.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.5
item.description: Movie and TV lookups in chat, more reliable research answers with tightened evidence handling, and answer quality settled before the reply is shown.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.4
item.description: A publication ledger with a daily report, multiple file attach, parallel tool execution, structured citation claims, the full GDELT code vocabularies, and a dedicated approval dialog.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.3
item.description: Reasoning streams live as it is produced, each turn yields one verdict with citation rule enforcement, tokens renew in the background, and the legacy interface is retired.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.2
item.description: The I Ching oracle ships in the backend with two step turns, a reference link on every reading, and oracle tiles that ask for your situation before they draw.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.1
item.description: The model list refreshes on a cold start, deleting an agent no longer clears every card, and chat attachments are preserved during document sync.

item.title: Sorana 1.1.0
item.description: The desktop interface is rebuilt in Rust and Tauri, the backend runs as a standalone service, external tool servers are managed in settings, and Sorana runs on MacOS, Linux and Windows.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.113
item.description: Research turns end in a dedicated final answer with no tool access, only verified specifics are published, and several review and refusal paths are fixed.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.112
item.description: Autonomy depth presets per agent, per memory kind follow switches, saved style rules survive long conversations, and a failed turn refuses instead of shipping a stub.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.111
item.description: External tools are called with the signature that server documents, every tool call is traced from request to result, and a turn carries a single deadline.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.110
item.description: The planner offers every tool an external server publishes, an empty response becomes a typed refusal, and a question about a document is answered from that document.
